name: Ahros
source:
Ahros (full name is Ahros Amtingale) – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change and an Azaries's love interest.
Ahros is a young yellow-eyed azure om'verai with white mane. Ahros has wide "eyebrows" and cheek fins with dark membranes, with both thin and wide head horns. Younger Ahros used to have both shorter mane and face.
Ahros is a young shy om'verai who acts like a matured serious man. Having to take care about younger brothers has built Ahros' mature personality. May be secretly in love with Azaries. Ahros enjoys meditating, playing videogames and has a hight sense of justice.
